rows.label: sell duplicate Prime parts first
rows.note: free Ducats from your existing stash

conditions: Ducat Kiosks are closed at Maroo's Bazaar; use a regular relay.
bonuses: During Prime Resurgence, Varzia exchanges Aya for Ducats at 5 per Aya; a poor rate, useful only for leftover Aya.

disclosures.title: build each Prime once first
disclosures.body: If you still need a Prime part for its own build, craft it before selling it for Ducats. Selling it first means farming the part again later.

groups.activity: check Baro's rotating stock, then buy if listed

live.text: check the Ducat Kiosk countdown for his next relay

rows.label: Prisma Skana
rows.note: 175,000 credits + 510 Ducats, only when in his rotating stock

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; Prisma Skana isn't guaranteed to be listed, and historical gaps between appearances have stretched to several months.
It arrives as the finished weapon: no blueprint, no crafting step.
bonuses: The annual TennoCon relay sells his entire back-catalog for one week, Prisma Skana included, but entry needs a Baro's Relay Ticket from the real-money TennoCon Digital Pack.
